AUTHOR BIO TEMPLATE
==================

Copy this file and replace every [bracketed] part with your own details.
Never include your home address, personal phone, or private email.

SHORT (25-50 words)
-------------------
[Full name] is a [role/credential] who writes [genre/topic] for [audience].
[Book title] is [one-line description]. Based in [state/region].
Find more at [website].

MEDIUM (75-125 words)
---------------------
[Full name] is a [role/credential] based in [state/region]. They write
[genre/topic] for [audience]. [One sentence of background or why this
topic matters to them]. [Book title] is [one-line description]. [Full
name] lives in [state/region] with [optional personal detail]. Readers
can sign up for [Full name]'s newsletter at [website].

LONG (150-250 words)
--------------------
[Full name] is a [role/credential] based in [state/region]. They write
[genre/topic] for [audience]. [Two or three sentences of background:
career, training, or lived experience that led to this book].

[Full name] wrote [Book title] because [the "why" behind the book, one
or two sentences]. [One sentence about what readers will get from it].
[Full name] lives in [state/region] with [family/pet/hobby].

Find more at [website] or sign up for the newsletter at [newsletter link].

EXAMPLE (replace with your own)
-------------------------------
Dylan Asdale is a registered nurse and founder of Asdale Dynamics, LLC, an
Indiana publisher of beginner-friendly AI education. He writes practical
guides that explain AI "like a friend would": plain English, step by step,
never condescending. His book The Massive AI Manual helps non-technical
readers use AI tools confidently. Dylan lives in Indiana.
Find his free guides and newsletter at dylanasdale.github.io.
